companies.name: Apple
companies.story: Almost everyone who owns one buys another. Hard to talk people out of.

companies.name: Costco
companies.story: Sells enormous amounts and keeps a sliver of each sale on purpose.

companies.name: Chipotle
companies.story: Opens hundreds of new restaurants a year. Each one is a new stand.

companies.name: Nike
companies.story: Everyone knows the brand, but people have been buying fewer pairs.

companies.name: Coca-Cola
companies.story: Grows slowly and very reliably. Has sold the same thing for a century.

companies.name: Roblox
companies.story: Growing fast and loved by millions. Still spends more than it takes in.

companies.name: Netflix
companies.story: Millions pay every month without thinking about it.

companies.name: Disney
companies.story: Sells a huge amount and keeps a small slice. The parks cost a fortune to run.

companies.name: McDonald's
companies.story: Mostly does not own the restaurants. Collects rent and a cut from the people who do.

companies.name: Starbucks
companies.story: Charges several times what the coffee costs, and people queue anyway.

companies.name: Amazon
companies.whatTheySell: Everything, plus the computers other companies run on
companies.story: The shopping is enormous and thin. The quiet computing business is where the profit is.

companies.name: Walmart
companies.story: Takes in more money than almost anyone and keeps two or three cents of each dollar.

companies.name: DoorDash
companies.whatTheySell: Somebody else's dinner, brought to you
companies.story: Cooks nothing. Takes a cut of the order, the delivery and the advert.

companies.name: Domino's
companies.story: Sells the dough and the ovens to its own franchisees. Two businesses in one.

companies.name: Lululemon
companies.story: Keeps a startling slice of every sale, because people will pay the sticker price.

companies.name: Take-Two
companies.story: Spends years and fortunes on one game, then finds out in a week whether it worked.

companies.name: Nvidia
companies.whatTheySell: The chips that AI runs on
companies.story: Does not have to pick which AI company wins. It sells to all of them.

companies.name: Microsoft
companies.story: Turned software you bought once into software you rent forever.

companies.name: Alphabet
companies.story: You have never paid it a penny. It is one of the most profitable companies alive.

companies.name: PayPal
companies.whatTheySell: Paying for things online, and Venmo
companies.story: Moves other people's money and keeps a sliver of every push of the button.

companies.name: Duolingo
companies.story: Almost everybody uses it for nothing. The business is the few who pay.

companies.name: Airbnb
companies.whatTheySell: Somewhere to stay, owned by somebody else
companies.story: Owns no houses. Takes a cut of every night booked in other people's.

companies.name: Uber
companies.story: Lost money for over a decade on purpose, buying the habit before the profit.

companies.name: Crocs
companies.story: Cheap to make, sold for a lot, and priced by the market as if it will go out of fashion.
